title: Sirloin Steak with Egyptian Spice
description: A flavorful and tender sirloin steak recipe with a hint of Egyptian spices. Pair it with a side of braised vegetables for a well-rounded meal.

ingredients.name: Egyptian Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: combine paprika, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper

ingredients.name: Braised Vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, bell peppers, and potatoes

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the Egyptian Spice Blend and olive oil.
Rub the spice mixture all over the sirloin steak, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the steak to a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 10-12 minutes or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
While the steak is cooking, heat some oil in a separate pan and sauté the chopped onion and garlic until softened.
Add the braised vegetables to the pan and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes or until they're tender.
Remove the steak from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced steak with the braised vegetables and enjoy!
